{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Earnings Quality and Momentum", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high earnings quality and strong momentum are likely to outperform due to their ability to sustain growth and maintain high profitability.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "NOA"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom12m"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "AbnormalAccruals", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24}, 

{"name": "Financial Distress and Leverage", 
"mechanism": "Firms with low financial distress and high leverage are likely to outperform due to their ability to take on debt and invest in growth opportunities.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OScore"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Leverage"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36}, 

{"name": "Innovation and Valuation", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high innovation and low valuation are likely to outperform due to their ability to create new products and services and maintain a competitive advantage.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "IdioVol3F", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18}, 

{"name": "Growth and Profitability", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high growth and high profitability are likely to outperform due to their ability to maintain high margins and invest in growth opportunities.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 48}, 

{"name": "Market Sentiment and Liquidity", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high market sentiment and high liquidity are likely to outperform due to their ability to attract investors and maintain a high trading volume.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "UpRecomm"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "VolMkt"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BidAskSpread", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24}, 

{"name": "Intangibles and Investment", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high intangibles and high investment are likely to outperform due to their ability to create new products and services and maintain a competitive advantage.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Investment"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36}, 

{"name": "Environmental and Social Governance", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high environmental and social governance are likely to outperform due to their ability to maintain a positive reputation and attract investors.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Governance"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "realestate"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "IdioVolAHT", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18}, 

{"name": "Financial Health and Efficiency", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high financial health and efficiency are likely to outperform due to their ability to maintain a high return on assets and minimize costs.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "roaq"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "CashProd"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 48}
]}
